items.title: Armand Hug Interview, 1960-07-14
items.q: Steve was on banjo and Horace Dias was on piano. Jink Morton on bass... But that was a good band of those days too.

ctx.x: The Lesley Hems records, they sound like nickels, you know. He made two tunes, I forget the date, but the late 20s, Johnny Harmon's Bayou's
was that when he used this piano player, Horace Dias? Was Horace Dias on some of those records with him?
